## Example 3.11 {#iv3-example-3-11 .vector-lesson .component-lesson .position-lesson}

Given $A(6,4,8)$ and $B(10,6,8)$ show that $\overrightarrow{AB}$ is parallel to the $x$-$y$ plane.

<div class="booklet-cue">Booklet Example 3.11 · p. 24</div>

::: notes
AB=(4,2,0). Both points lie at z=8, while the displacement has zero z-component. The segment AB lies in the plane z=8 and does not lie in the xy-plane z=0. Its direction is parallel to that plane. Complete the component calculation in OneNote and use the zero vertical component to justify parallelism.
:::
